datasetDef: SUBJECT-LEVEL multi-view alignment, n=250 UCLA CNP subjects with both views: X = 83 morphometry features (DK thickness + eTIV-normalized volumes), Y = resting-state connectivity (2278 Fisher-z edges, PCA-50). This is the multi-view analysis NOESIS deferred until two REAL views shared entities richly — same individuals, two independent MRI-derived modalities. Alignment = shared anatomy-function individual variation in ONE dataset; not disorder-specific, not causal.
preprocessing: Age + gender residualized from BOTH views (full sample) before CCA, so demographics cannot manufacture alignment; connectivity reduced to PCA-50 (fit on residualized features).
model: CCA, 5 components; 1000 row permutations of the connectivity view (subjects are exchangeable rows — no block structure at subject level), refit per permutation, per-component p = (1+#perm>=observed)/(1+N); no deflation across components (components >= 2 approximate; claims rest on component 1).
